description: Runs a recorded delivery again through the skill as it is now, as a new job with trigger `replay`: the original payload, headers and query, no signature check, `when` filters applied unless skip_filters, identical in-flight work is reused when deduplication is enabled on the running server. A delivery that was rejected needs `force` (its body was never verified). Uses the running server when there is one, otherwise runs in-process.

force.description: replay a delivery that was rejected or errored

skip_filters.description: run even when the skill's `when` conditions do not match the original request

name: replay_delivery
title: Replay delivery
